title: Cities of Refuge and the Law on Killing
description: The Lord speaks to Moses on the plains of Moab and commands that the Israelites give the Levites 48 cities to live in, with pasturelands around them. Six of these are to be cities of refuge, three on each side of the Jordan, where someone who has killed a person by accident can flee from the avenger of blood. The chapter clearly distinguishes between intentional murder, which is punished with death according to the testimony of witnesses, and unintentional killing, where the killer must remain in the city of refuge until the death of the high priest. No ransom may be accepted for blood, because blood defiles the land where the Lord dwells among his people.
